C1230.title: Meituan Under Antitrust Investigation for "Exclusive Dealing" with Potential Fine Up to 12 Billion Yuan
C1230.summary: On April 26, 2021, the State Administration for Market Regulation initiated an antitrust investigation into Meituan over suspected monopolistic practices including "exclusive dealing." Prior to this, Meituan had been ordered to compensate Ele.me in unfair competition cases in Jinhua, Zhejiang and Huai'an, Jiangsu.
